hero.status: A knowledge surface designed for production use
hero.summary: Groundpath keeps retrieval, conversation, citations, and review on one working surface so teams can establish scope, evidence, and trust before AI touches real operations.
hero.support: When responses are about to enter a business workflow, teams do not need louder generation. They need tighter source boundaries, steadier context control, and an evidence trail they can revisit.

archives.label: Live archives
archives.detail: Maintained knowledge bases, documents, and versioned objects

scope.label: Default scoping
scope.detail: Ground the answer in approved context before generation begins

evidence.label: Citation coverage
evidence.detail: Responses return with source position, freshness, and review state

showcase.label: Research preview
showcase.title: What teams want from AI is not longer output. It is fewer hallucinations, tighter scope control, and evidence that can be reviewed.
showcase.description: The center of the homepage makes that explicit: every answer should arrive with source context, sync freshness, and reviewability instead of hiding that information on another screen.

releases.label: Latest releases
releases.title: Turn the platform narrative into browsable release cards.
releases.description: Archive systems, scoped answers, and verification rails should not be buried inside a crowded navigation model.
releases.support: This homepage shifts away from stacked SaaS sections. It reads more like a research front page: declare the stance, reveal the capabilities, then show the path in.

archive.title: Treat the knowledge base as an operating asset, not as upload residue.
archive.description: Documents, versions, tags, and source boundaries remain durable. Retrieval reads from structured archives instead of guessing context from loose fragments.

conversation.title: Run the answer inside the archive instead of outside it.
conversation.description: Questions, follow-ups, and citations share one surface so teams do not have to stitch evidence back together across multiple screens.

verification.title: Keep the verification rail beside the answer, not on a later screen.
verification.description: Sync freshness, citation completeness, and review state remain attached to the response so operators can do one last check before acting.

principles.label: Principles
principles.title: An AI homepage should not only show capability. It should show how trust is built.
principles.description: Groundpath compresses research, product, and access into one narrative: define scope first, permit generation second, keep evidence beside the answer last.

sources.title: Citations should stay attached to the answer.
sources.description: The moment a response loses its sources, it becomes harder to trust inside any high-stakes workflow.

archives.title: Knowledge objects need a stable identity.
archives.description: Bases, documents, versions, and tags define what an answer can touch. That structure should survive retrieval.

responses.title: Scope control comes before generation delight.
responses.description: Strong AI interaction does not answer freely and add constraints later. It limits context first, then decides whether generation should continue.

audit.title: Review belongs inside the workflow.
audit.description: Freshness, approval status, and risk notes should appear beside the answer, not only inside backend logs.

footer.tagline: Built for teams that need traceable knowledge, scoped answers, and reviewable evidence.

hero.title: About Groundpath
hero.description: Groundpath is a knowledge archive workbench for teams that need retrieval, conversation, and verification to live on the same system surface.

trusted.title: Retrievable by design
trusted.description: Archive documents as structured objects so scope and recall remain stable under production use.

knowledge.title: Conversational in context
knowledge.description: Keep questions and answers inside the same archive space that defines their scope and evidence.

semantic.title: Verifiable under review
semantic.description: Expose citations, source freshness, and version state so every answer can be checked before action.
